spans.s:
शौर शौर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शूर), relating to
a hero, heroic.

सौर सौर, अस्, ई, अम् (in some senses fr.
सूर, in others fr. सुर), belonging or relating to
the sun, solar; sacred to Sūrya or the sun; celestial,
divine; relating to spirituous liquor; (अस्), m. a
worshipper of the sun; the planet Saturn [cf. सूर-
सुत]; a solar month (consisting of thirty risings
and settings of the sun or the period during which
the sun is in one sign of the zodiac); a representation
of a solar zodiacal sign used at marriage ceremonies;
a solar day; N. of a Guru; the Tumburu plant;
(ई), f. the wife of the sun; (अम्), n., N. of a col-
lection of hymns addressed to Sūrya (extracted from
[]
the Ṛg-veda).
—सौर-ज, अस्, m. ‘sun-born,’ the
Tumburu plant.
—सौर-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a
chapter of the Śiva-Purāṇa.
—सौर-दिवस, अस्, m.
a solar day.
—सौर-नक्त, अम्, n. a particular reli-
gious observance (accompanied with ceremonial ablu-
tions, worship of the sun, &c.).
—सौर-भुवन,
अम्, n. = सूर्य-लोक, q. v.
—सौर-मास, अस्, m.
a solar month.
—सौर-संवत्सर, अस्, m. a solar
year.
—सौर-संहिता, f., N. of part of the Skanda-
Purāṇa.
—सौर-सिद्धान्त, अस्, m., N. of one of
five ancient astronomical Siddhāntas or text-books,
(see सिद्धान्त, cf. सूर्य-स्˚.)
—सौर-सूक्त, अम्,
n. a hymn addressed to Sūrya.
—सौरोपपुराण
(˚र-उप्˚), अम्, n., N. of an Upa-Purāṇa.
शौरदेव्यः, in Ṛg-veda
VIII. 70, 15

. appa-
rently acc. pl. of शौरदेवी, qualifying गाः, ‘cows,’
and explained by Sāy. thus, दीव्यन्ति क्रीडन्त

इति
देवा

योद्धारः शूराश्-च ते देवाश्-च शूर-देवाः,
तेषां हितं शौरदेवं युद्धं तत्-सम्-
बन्धिन्यो गाः.

शौरसेन, अम्, n. (fr. शूर-सेन), the language
spoken by the people of Śūra-sena; (ई), f. a Prākṛt
dialect supposed to have been spoken at Mathurā.

सौरसेन सौरसेन, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people
or district; (ई), f., scil. भाषा, the language spoken
in the above district; [cf. शौरसेनी.]

शौरि, इस्, m., N. of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; of Bala-
rāma (as descended from Śūra); the planet Saturn.

सौरि, इस्, m., N. of the planet Saturn (as son of
the Sun); the tree Asana (q. v.); the plant Āditya-
bhaktā (q. v.).
—सौरि-रत्न, अम्, n. a particular
gem (sapphire).
सौरी, f. See above under सौर.

शौर्य, अम्, n. heroism, valour, prowess, might;
the heroic branch of the dramatic art, representation
of war and supernatural events on the stage (= आर-
भटी).
—शौर्योपार्जित (˚य-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ac-
quired by valour.

सौर्य, अस्, ई, अम्, of or belonging to the sun,
solar; (अस्), m. a patronymic of several Vedic Ṛṣis
(authors of hymns in the Ṛg-veda).

शौर्प शौर्प, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शूर्प), measured
by a winnowing basket &c., belonging to a winnow-
ing fan &c.
शौर्पणाय्य, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
शौर्पिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = शौर्प above.
सौरक, N. of a town founded by Surendra.

सौरसैन्धव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सुर-सिन्धु),
belonging to the river Ganges, Gangetic; related to
the Ganges (applicable as an epithet to Bhīṣma);
(अस्), m. a horse of the Sun (in this sense com-
pounded of सौर and सैन्धव, q. v.).

सौरीय, अस्, ई, अम्, solar, belonging or suitable to
the sun (= सूर्याय हित).

सौरेय or सौरेयक, अस्, m. the white Barleria
(a shrub bearing white flowers).

सौर्यायणि, इस्, or सौर्यायणिन्, ई, m. a de-
scendant of Saurya.
सौरथ सौरथ, अस्, m. (fr. सु-रथ), a hero.

सौरभ सौरभ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सु-रभि),
fragrant; (अस्), m. a proper N.; (ई), f. a cow; a
daughter of the cow Su-rabhi; (अम्), n. fragrance;
saffron; N. of a commentary.
सौरभक, अम्, n. a particular metre.

सौरभेय, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to
Su-rabhi; (अस्), m. an ox; (ई), f. a cow; the daughter
of Su-rabhi.
—सौरभेय-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a
Tantra work.

सौरभ्य, अम्, n. fragrance, sweet-scentedness,
odour; pleasingness, agreeableness, beauty; good cha-
racter, good reputation, fame; (अस्), m., N. of Kuvera.

सौरस सौरस, अस्, m., N. of a Vihāra
founded by king Surendra.

सौरसेय सौरसेय, अस्, m. (fr. सु-रसा), ‘off-
spring of Su-rasā,’ epithet of Skanda.

सौरस्य, अम्, n. (fr. सु-रस), well-flavoured-
ness, tastiness, savoriness.

सौराज्य सौराज्य, अम्, n. (fr. सु-राज), good
government.

सौराष्ट्र सौराष्ट्र, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. सु-
राष्ट्र), belonging or relating to the district of
Surāt; (अस्), m. the district of Surāt; the resin of
the plant Boswellia Thurifera; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
people inhabiting part of Bhārata-varṣa; (आ), f.
a sort of fragrant earth, = तुवरी; (ई), f. a sort of
fragrant earth found in Surāt; (अम्), n. a kind of
amalgam of zinc and copper, bell-metal, brass.
—सौ-
राष्ट्र-देश, अस्, m. the country of Surāt.
—सौ-
राष्ट्र-मृत्तिका, f. Surāt earth.

सौराष्ट्रक, अम्, n. a sort of white or bell-
metal; a kind of amalgam of five metals (= पञ्च-
लोह).

सौराष्ट्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the dis-
trict of Surāt; (अम्), n. a sort of poison, (according
[]
to some, of a kind of snake; according to others, a
vegetable or mineral.)
